paper_metadata.title: Theoretical study of mechanical and thermodynamic properties of W–Fe alloys: Promising ultra-high temperature alloy materials

evidence.quote: In this paper, three kinds of W–Fe alloy models are constructed, namely W15Fe1, W14Fe2 and W13Fe3 alloys.
this study predicts the mechanical and thermodynamic properties of W–Fe alloys based on first-principles methods.
The mechanical and thermodynamic properties of W, W15Fe1 and W14Fe2 alloys are investigated
